changelog.en: New: if an add-on connects to online services, its details show the provider with a link to its website, the services and what is sent to them.
changelog.de: Neu: Verbindet sich ein Add-on mit Online-Diensten, zeigen seine Details den Anbieter mit Link zu seiner Website, die Dienste und was an sie übertragen wird.
changelog.fr: Nouveau : si un module se connecte à des services en ligne, ses détails indiquent le fournisseur avec un lien vers son site web, les services et ce qui leur est transmis.
changelog.it: Novità: se un componente aggiuntivo si connette a servizi online, i suoi dettagli mostrano il fornitore con un link al suo sito web, i servizi e cosa viene loro trasmesso.
changelog.es: Novedad: si un complemento se conecta a servicios en línea, sus detalles muestran el proveedor con un enlace a su sitio web, los servicios y lo que se les transmite.
changelog.nl: Nieuw: als een add-on verbinding maakt met onlinediensten, tonen de details de aanbieder met een link naar zijn website, de diensten en wat ernaar wordt verstuurd.
changelog.pt: Novidade: se um suplemento se ligar a serviços online, os seus detalhes mostram o fornecedor com uma ligação para o seu site, os serviços e o que lhes é transmitido.
changelog.da: Nyt: Hvis et tilføjelsesprogram forbinder til onlinetjenester, viser detaljerne udbyderen med et link til dens websted, tjenesterne og hvad der sendes til dem.
changelog.fi: Uutta: jos lisäosa muodostaa yhteyden verkkopalveluihin, sen tiedot näyttävät tarjoajan ja linkin sen verkkosivustolle, palvelut ja mitä niille lähetetään.
changelog.nb: Nytt: Hvis et tillegg kobler til nettjenester, viser detaljene leverandøren med lenke til nettstedet, tjenestene og hva som sendes til dem.
changelog.sv: Nytt: Om ett tillägg ansluter till onlinetjänster visar detaljerna leverantören med en länk till webbplatsen, tjänsterna och vad som skickas till dem.
changelog.pl: Nowość: jeśli dodatek łączy się z usługami online, jego szczegóły pokazują dostawcę z linkiem do witryny, usługi i to, co jest do nich przesyłane.
changelog.cs: Novinka: pokud se doplněk připojuje k online službám, jeho podrobnosti ukazují poskytovatele s odkazem na jeho web, služby a co se jim předává.
changelog.hu: Újdonság: ha egy bővítmény online szolgáltatásokhoz csatlakozik, a részletei megmutatják a szolgáltatót a webhelyére mutató hivatkozással, a szolgáltatásokat és azt, hogy mi kerül hozzájuk.
changelog.ru: Новое: если надстройка подключается к онлайн-службам, в ее сведениях показаны поставщик со ссылкой на его веб-сайт, службы и то, что им передается.
changelog.tr: Yeni: Bir eklenti çevrimiçi hizmetlere bağlanıyorsa ayrıntıları, web sitesi bağlantısıyla sağlayıcıyı, hizmetleri ve onlara ne gönderildiğini gösterir.
changelog.zh-Hans: 新增：如果加载项连接到在线服务，其详细信息会显示提供商及其网站链接、这些服务以及发送给它们的内容。
changelog.zh-Hant: 新增：如果增益集連線到線上服務，其詳細資訊會顯示提供者及其網站連結、這些服務以及傳送給它們的內容。
changelog.ja: 新機能: アドオンがオンライン サービスに接続する場合、詳細に提供者とその Web サイトへのリンク、サービス、送信される内容が表示されます。

changelog.ar: جديد: إذا كانت الوظيفة الإضافية تتصل بخدمات عبر الإنترنت، تعرض تفاصيلها المزوّد مع رابط إلى موقعه والخدمات وما يُرسل إليها.

complianceAudit.method: Checked all #include directives and linker inputs of PluginStore.vcxproj (Windows SDK incl. BCrypt/Crypt32 for SHA-256 and the ECDSA signature check, MFC/ATL, Tungsten Power PDF Plugin SDK only), the bundled UILayout and icon files (own work, icons drawn by client/res/make_icons.py) and the package contents. One third-party component: the Microsoft WebView2 SDK static loader (BSD-3-Clause), linked into PluginStore.zxt; its NOTICE lists only BSD-licensed .NET tooling that is not used. The bundled MSI is built with the WiX Toolset v3 (build tool; its standard WixUI dialog resources are part of the installer). No credentials, personal data or third-party trademarks in the package. The only network service is the configured Add-on Store server (HTTPS). Since 1.9.8 the setup shows, on a Power PDF licensed with a serial number, a dialog whose button "Request a quote" opens Tungsten Automation's public quote page in the default browser (only on that click, never in silent installs); the setup itself sends nothing. The MSI also installs AddonStoreLink.exe (own code, no network access), which handles addonstore:// links by passing a validated package id to the client.

externalServices.name: Add-on Store server (configurable; default addon.power-pdf.de, Azure address ppdf-store.azurewebsites.net)
externalServices.data: Catalog, search and package downloads; sends the Power PDF UI language, the beta channel flag and, only when the user or IT entered one, the customer code of a delivery (X-Customer-Code header). The catalog is also read once in the background about 15 seconds after Power PDF starts and after the store window closes, to show the update badge (IT can switch this off with the policy UpdateBadge = 0). No personal data, no documents.

externalServices.name: Tungsten Automation quote page (setup only, serial-number Power PDF)
externalServices.data: None from the setup: the button opens the public page in the default browser (tungstenautomation.de for German, .fr for French, .com otherwise); the browser then talks to that website as with any link.

elevation.reason: Installing, updating and removing add-ons writes to Power PDF's Plug-Ins folder in Program Files: one PowerShell step runs elevated after the UAC prompt, only when the user installs, updates or removes an add-on (the self-update starts msiexec the same way).
